newsitem.title: UK: Jardine Strategic to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Strategic to buy back shares.

text.p: Jardine Strategic Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it planned to buy back up to 50 million ordinary shares, subject to market conditions.
The group also said it expects that its earnings for the full year, excluding non-recurring items, will fall short of earnings in 1995.

Chairman Henry Keswick said, "With mixed performances from the companies in which the group holds its strategic investments, underlying earnings per share declined modestly, and the expectation is that earnings for the full year, excluding non-recurring items, will also fall short of those of 1995."
Earnings per share in the first half of 1996, excluding non-recurring items, fell by six percent.
